## 📌 Summary
<!--
Describe what changed and why, in enough detail that a reviewer who has NOT read
the issue can follow it. A single line is not enough — PRs with a one-line
description will be sent back.

Cover:
  - The problem this solves, and what the behaviour was before
  - The approach you took, and any alternative you considered and rejected
  - Anything the reviewer should look at closely, or that you are unsure about
  - How you verified it (tests added, commands run, manual checks)
-->
